test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some goods are beautiful.

Some beautiful are costly.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some goods are costly.

II. All costly are beautiful.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.
Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ec528e69fd4d2a535b823789a8ae441a0f2365cac74b6aa7ac7d17586f3ec04.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some goods are costly. → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. All costly are beautiful. → False (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, **neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows**.
